subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the production (in thousands) of two types (A and B) of cars by a company over the years 2016 to 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3d5060a47c74b43645a86a3bd472bb4fb6dd55707fb06b3432d95e780a9ebfd.png] 

In how many of the given years was the production of type A cars more than the average production of this type car in the given years?
solution:
**Given:**

Production data of Type A cars over the years 2016 to 2021 (as shown in the line graph).

**Calculations:**

Production of Type A cars in each year:

2016: 100 thousand

2017: 125 thousand

2018: 200 thousand

2019: 250 thousand

2020: 300 thousand

2021: 400 thousand

Calculate the average production:

⇒ Average production = (100 + 125 + 200 + 250 + 300 + 400) / 6

⇒ Average production = 1375 / 6

⇒ Average production ≈ 229.17 thousand

Years when the production was more than the average:

2018: 200 thousand (less than average)

2019: 250 thousand (more than average)

2020: 300 thousand (more than average)

2021: 400 thousand (more than average)

∴ The production of Type A cars was more than the average production in 3 years: 2019, 2020, and 2021.&l
